title: Order Defects Under Seller Performance Standing: What Counts and When It Is Removed
content:
**Clause.** An order becomes defective for the seller when it receives negative seller feedback, when a Northloop Guarantee claim on it is granted and funded by the seller, or when a chargeback on it is debited to the seller; a seller cancellation is recorded as a defect type of its own that feeds the cancellation rate, not the defect rate. A claim funded by Northloop is never a defect. A defect is removed when the negative feedback is removed after a dispute, when the seller wins the chargeback dispute, or when the guarantee claim decision is reversed on appeal in the seller's favour. Several defects on one order count as one defective order.

Each defect is recorded on the seller's Seller Performance Standing record for the order concerned and the kind of defect, with the date it arose; a removal is recorded the same way with the reason for removal, and a removed defect stops counting.

## What makes an order defective

| Event on the order | Defect? | Feeds |
|---|---|---|
| Negative seller feedback received | yes | order defect rate |
| Northloop Guarantee claim granted and funded by the seller | yes | order defect rate |
| Northloop Guarantee claim funded by Northloop | never | — |
| Chargeback debited to the seller | yes | order defect rate |
| Seller cancellation | recorded as a defect type of its own | cancellation rate, not the defect rate |

## What removes a defect

| Defect | Removed when |
|---|---|
| Negative seller feedback | the negative feedback is removed after a dispute |
| Chargeback | the seller wins the chargeback dispute |
| Granted guarantee claim | the guarantee claim decision is reversed on appeal in the seller's favour |

## Cases (hypothetical)

1. An order receives negative seller feedback and a chargeback debited to the seller. It counts as one defective order, not two.
2. The seller then wins the chargeback dispute. The chargeback defect is removed; the negative feedback defect remains, so the order is still one defective order.
3. A guarantee claim on another order is granted and funded by Northloop. That order is not defective on account of the claim.
